decisions.reason: The polymer concrete drain housing had a dedicated page in both 2018 and 2019, which signals ongoing commitment, and keeping a component that fits Dallmer's drainage portfolio costs little.
The floor-level shower drainage system moved from a mention to its own page, so its value appears to be resolving favourably in a core growth segment, which justifies keeping the option open.
Website prominence fell from a dedicated page to a mere mention, a weak signal of disappointing results, but a design variant within an existing range is cheap to maintain while uncertainty remains.
The shower element was only ever mentioned, so its prospects are still uncertain, but it complements the shower drainage line at low holding cost and remains worth keeping as an option.
The DallSafe 200 backflow drain rose to the home page, showing strong commitment and resolved positive value given rising awareness of flooding and backflow risk.
The air-admittance valve is a low-cost accessory that has stayed listed; dropping it would save little, so the option is kept despite its low visibility.
